sources.author: Tao Li
sources.title: Daily mean discharge and suspended sediment concentration from 2015 to 2021 at Lijin station
sources.original_source: Chinese Hydrological Yearbook, as attributed by the archive author
sources.modifications: None; original XLSX retained byte-for-byte. The common-period count excludes the extra 2022-01-01 record without altering the file.
sources.daily_definition: Source calendar date labels retained. The workbook does not specify its civil-day timezone convention.
sources.quality_note: No per-record instrument-quality flags are supplied in the workbook. Public archiving is not independent validation of the original measurements.

sources.station: Mississippi River at St. Louis, MO
sources.author: U.S. Geological Survey
sources.license: US Government work in the public domain
sources.modifications: None; the downloaded API response and native ft³/s values are retained. The conversion factor is documented, not applied to the downloadable original file.
sources.daily_definition: USGS daily mean (statistic 00003); original calendar date labels retained, not interpreted as simultaneous UTC instantaneous observations.
sources.quality_note: 39 days estimated, including 15 also equipment-flagged; 2 provider-interpolated days. No project interpolation, imputation or generated observations.

provenance.publication_note: Real daily discharge models for Lijin and St. Louis only. Legacy synthetic experiments are not used by this site. Forecasts extend a historical cutoff and are not live operational forecasts.

protocol.model: single-station residual GRU, not a physics-informed model
protocol.normalization: mean/std of each river's raw training period only; target full training-input statistics also used for zero-shot
protocol.checkpoint_selection: minimum normalized MSE on full validation labels, never test labels
protocol.missing_data: no interpolation/imputation; windows containing missing calendar days are skipped
protocol.historical_context: validation/test inputs may include previously observed days from earlier partitions; targets remain disjoint
protocol.test_evaluation: rolling single-day prediction with observed past context, not multi-year free-running forecast
protocol.target_label_budget: every fifth eligible training window; approximately 20% of target supervised LOSS windows, not 20% of observed inputs
protocol.transfer_budget: target-only/fine-tuned have same labeled windows, batches, epochs and updates; full target validation labels and training-input scaler outside reduced budget; source pretraining adds labels and compute
protocol.nrmse_definition: RMSE divided by target TEST observed range
protocol.std_definition: sample standard deviation across seeds, ddof=1; not a confidence interval
protocol.forecast_note: 2022-01-01 through 2022-01-06 from the archived 2021-12-31 cutoff; not a current 2026 forecast; no future observed labels supplied
protocol.nonnegativity: learned physical predictions clipped at zero
protocol.daily_dates: native source calendar labels retained, not simultaneous UTC measurements
protocol.seasonality: descriptive monthly mean over the common period, not a model input or training normalization statistic
